### `src/markers.ts` — 5 exported wrapper functions + owned types

| Function | Signature | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `appendRewindMarker` | `(pi, ctx, data: RewindMarkerInput) → string \| null` | Stamps `{schema,v,kind,id:uuid,seq,ts}`, calls `pi.appendEntry("mulligan:rewind", ...)`, captures leaf id via `getLeafId()` (C7) |
| `appendShrinkMarker` | `(pi, ctx, data: ShrinkMarkerInput) → string \| null` | Same pattern, kind `"shrink"`, stamps `id` |
| `appendTurnMetric` | `(pi, ctx, data: TurnMetricInput) → string \| null` | Same pattern, kind `"turn-metric"`, **no id** (spec/04 §5) |
| `leaveNote` | `(pi, note: LeaveNoteInput) → void` | Calls `pi.sendMessage(...)` with `display:true`, NO options arg (C8) |
| `setCheckpoint` | `(pi, ctx, name) → string \| null` | Calls `pi.setLabel(leafId, "mulligan:checkpoint:" + name)` (C9) |

All wrappers are fail-open (never throw), import shared types from canonical owners (Granularity/NoteInput/FileLedger/ShrinkTarget), and read `ctx.sessionManager` fresh each call (C12).

### `test/markers.test.ts` — 42 tests across 14 describe blocks
- Envelope/customType/seq/ts stamping for all 3 marker types
- Id rules (rewind+shrink=uuid, turn-metric=none)
- Seq monotonic + per-session isolation (shared counter)
- C7 leaf-id capture + call order
- Leaf-null path (returns null, marker still appended)
- Never-throws fail-open (throwing pi/ctx methods)
- Read-back type=custom (not custom_message)
- leaveNote (sendMessage, no options, void, custom_message channel)
- setCheckpoint (setLabel prefix, getLabel round-trip C9)
- Compile-time type assertions via expectTypeOf
